name: pile_project_overview
description: Read the open pile project's name, counts, and analysis status.

name: pile_get_project_settings
description: Read project properties, CPT selection, grouping, cost, complete visual legend, and optimization settings. The optimization budget_basis_points is extra cost above the cost-only reference solution (500 means 5%), not above the current plan cost.

name: pile_list_load_points
description: List load points and their assignments in a plan.

name: pile_get_load_point
description: Read one load point, its CPT selection, group, and assigned pile option.

name: pile_list_cpts
description: List CPT positions and advice counts.

name: pile_get_cpt_advice
description: Read foundation advice rows for one CPT.

name: pile_list_groups
description: List current effective load-point groups.

name: pile_list_plans
description: List pile plans and their assignment counts.

name: pile_get_plan
description: Read one pile plan and its assignment summary.

name: pile_list_pile_options
description: List Rust-evaluated pile options for one load point.

name: pile_get_plan_costs
description: Calculate the current cost estimate for a plan via the Rust core.

name: pile_compare_plans
description: Compare two explicit plans: assignments, locks, Rust costs, and paged load-point differences. A cost delta is omitted if either plan has missing prices.

name: pile_get_plan_optimization
description: Read a plan's committed optimization result and diagnostics. The solution.reference.cost is from the cost-only phase without coherence optimization; solution.budget is the resulting maximum allowed cost. Check both reference and returned-plan proof fields.

name: pile_get_current_optimization
description: Read the current transient optimization run status or outcome. A solved result reports the cost-only reference and coherence budget separately, with independent optimality proofs.

name: pile_get_technical_assessment
description: Read current Rust technical issues and group assignment conflicts.

name: pile_start_optimization
description: Start a cost-only reference solve, then optimize coherence within the reference cost plus budget_basis_points. Current plan assignments may seed the search but current plan cost does not set the budget. A rerun is a new search and is not guaranteed to improve the prior result. Return a run ID immediately; solved results are one Undo step.

name: pile_stop_optimization
description: Stop the named run and retain its best valid solution, if any.

name: pile_cancel_optimization
description: Cancel the named run and discard its result.

name: pile_duplicate_plan
description: Duplicate a pile plan and activate the copy. Undoable project change.

name: pile_rename_plan
description: Rename a pile plan. Undoable project change.

name: pile_assign_configuration
description: Assign a pile configuration to a load point and its effective group. Undoable project change.

name: pile_clear_assignment
description: Remove the pile assignment from a load point and its effective group. Undoable project change.

name: pile_activate_plan
description: Activate an existing pile plan. Matches UI navigation and does not add an undo step.

name: pile_delete_plan
description: Delete a pile plan if another plan remains. Undoable project change.

name: pile_set_load_point_lock
description: Lock or unlock one load point in the active pile plan. Undoable project change.

name: pile_set_manual_cpts
description: Replace manual CPT selection for one load point. An empty list explicitly selects none.

name: pile_use_automatic_cpts
description: Remove manual CPT selection for one load point and use automatic selection.

name: pile_group_load_points
description: Group selected effective load-point units through the Rust core. Undoable project change.

name: pile_ungroup_load_points
description: Separate the effective group containing this load point through the Rust core.

name: pile_set_assignments_bulk
description: Set or clear per-location assignments atomically in the active plan. One Undo step.

name: pile_set_load_point_locks_bulk
description: Set per-location locks atomically in the active plan. One Undo step.

name: pile_set_cpt_selections_bulk
description: Set manual CPT lists or restore automatic selection per location atomically. One Undo step.

name: pile_ungroup_load_points_bulk
description: Separate distinct effective groups atomically. One Undo step.

name: pile_set_cpt_selection_settings
description: Set projectwide automatic CPT rules; optionally replace manual CPT choices. One Undo step.

name: pile_set_cpt_selection_settings_bulk
description: Set different automatic CPT rules per load point atomically. One Undo step.

name: pile_set_grouping_settings
description: Set automatic grouping and/or maximum group distance. One Undo step.

name: pile_reset_group_overrides
description: Clear all manual joins and explicit automatic-group separations. One Undo step.

name: pile_add_cost_item
description: Add one pile-size cost row. One Undo step.

name: pile_update_cost_item
description: Change shape and/or unit cost for one pile size. One Undo step.

name: pile_remove_cost_item
description: Remove one unused pile-size cost row. One Undo step.

name: pile_edit_cost_catalog_bulk
description: Apply up to 500 add, update, or remove cost-row actions atomically. One Undo step.

name: pile_set_optimization_settings
description: Patch project-owned optimization settings. budget_basis_points is extra cost above the cost-only reference, not the current plan. One Undo step.

name: pile_set_active_configurations
description: Replace active pile sizes and tip levels for one plan. Values must exist in foundation advice. One Undo step.

name: pile_set_legend_settings
description: Replace the complete project legend, including mode, color schemes, symbols, colors, and automatic flags. Read the current legend first. One Undo step.

name: pile_set_project_properties
description: Set project name, pile head level in metres, and ISO currency code together. One Undo step.

name: pile_edit_load_points_bulk
description: Add, replace, or remove up to 500 load points atomically. Updates supply the complete row. Removing a point clears its plan assignments, locks, and selections. One Undo step.

name: pile_edit_cpts_bulk
description: Add, replace, or remove up to 500 CPTs atomically. Updates supply the complete row. Removing a CPT also removes its advice and manual references. One Undo step.

name: pile_edit_foundation_advice_bulk
description: Add, replace, or remove up to 500 foundation-advice rows atomically. A row key is CPT ID, pile size in mm, and tip level in mm; updates supply the complete row. One Undo step.
